_comment: BRAX (Brazilian Chest X-Ray) v1.1.0 — PhysioNet credentialed-access release. ~24,959 studies / ~40,967 images / 19,351 patients from a Brazilian hospital network. 14 CheXpert findings (NLP-derived from Portuguese radiology reports using the original CheXpert labeller). Per the BRAX paper: '1' = positive, '0' = negation, '-1' = uncertainty; blank cells mean the labeller did not extract a mention. Both DICOM and PNG variants ship in the same release under <root>/Anonymized_DICOMs/ and <root>/images/. Reports are NOT distributed in 1.1.0 — only the labels are, so output_report is unsupported. Two registered dataset classes share one harmonizer parameterised by image_format ('dicom' or 'png'). Default uncertain_strategy='raw' preserves the source 1/0/-1/NaN encoding cell-for-cell; opt into the four CheXpert-paper coercions (u_zeros / u_ones / u_ignore / drop) at construction time when training-ready 0/1 tensors are needed.

primary_csv._comment: Single master CSV at the BRAX root; contains every row for both DICOM and PNG variants.

patient_id._comment: Direct column. Randomly generated identifier per the de-identification protocol.

study_id._comment: AccessionNumber is the DICOM Study identifier; randomised but stable per study.

image_path._comment: DicomPath / PngPath in master_spreadsheet.csv are relative to the BRAX root (e.g. 'Anonymized_DICOMs/id_xxx/Study_yyy/Series_zzz/image-aaa.dcm'). base_image_dir is the BRAX root itself; no prefix stripping needed. Selected by the harmonizer's image_format parameter.

labels._comment: 14 CheXpert-aligned findings, same names and same {-1, 0, 1, NaN} semantics. -1 means 'uncertain' (CheXpert labeller flagged a mention but couldn't disambiguate). NaN cells indicate the mention was not extracted by the labeller and are conventionally treated as negative.

separate_csv._comment: Labels are in master_spreadsheet.csv alongside the path columns.

uncertain_handling._comment: Default 'raw' preserves every cell exactly as it appears in master_spreadsheet.csv (1 / 0 / -1 / NaN). The other four strategies match the CheXpert-paper ablations and apply NaN→0 first, then map -1 per the strategy: u_zeros (-1→0), u_ones (-1→1), u_ignore (-1→NaN), drop (drop rows with any -1). Override via the uncertain_strategy parameter on the harmonizer / dataset constructor.

view_position._comment: ViewPosition column carries DICOM-defined codes: AP, PA, LL, RL, RLD, LLD, RLO, LLO. Both frontal and lateral views are kept; downstream consumers can filter via dataframe slice if frontal-only is desired.

reports._comment: BRAX 1.1.0 does NOT distribute the source radiology reports — only the NLP-derived labels are released. output_report is unsupported and silently ignored with a warning.

extra_init_params.image_format: 'dicom' (default) selects the DicomPath column; 'png' selects PngPath. Two thin dataset subclasses (BRAXDataset, BRAXPNGDataset) hard-set this so callers don't have to.
extra_init_params.uncertain_strategy: 'raw' (default) preserves source cell values exactly. Other options ('u_zeros', 'u_ones', 'u_ignore', 'drop') apply NaN→0 then map -1 per the CheXpert-paper ablations.

custom_preprocessing: Series ID is extracted from the image path's 'Series_<UID>' segment via regex so multi-series studies stay groupable. Demographic / scanner metadata (PatientSex, PatientAge, Manufacturer, StudyDate) flow through EXTRA_OUTPUT_COLS and are renamed to snake_case. Both views (AP/PA/LL/...) are retained by default. Note: PatientAge is binned into 5-year groups in the de-identified release with an '85 or more' cap — treat as ordinal categorical, not continuous.
